# dsh-explorer
English · 简体中文
Native workspace file explorer plugin engineered specifically for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Bridges lo
cal workspace navigation and AI-assisted conversation workflows with seamless chat referencing, flui
d animations, and editor tab integration.
## Key Features

### 1. Conversational Chat Integration
* **Precision Drag & Drop**: Drop files or folders into the D
SH chat composer with exact text cursor / insertion point positioning, preserving existing words wit

hout clobbering text.
* **Smart Mention Chips**: Files dropped or inserted appear as `@path/to/file`

chips, and directories appear with trailing slash `@path/to/folder/`.
* **Modifier Drop Snippets**:
Hold **Alt** or **Shift** while dropping a file to embed its full source code directly into the cha

t prompt as a syntax-highlighted markdown code block.
* **One-Click Mentioning**: Click the `@` hove
r icon on any row or select *Insert Mention to Chat* from the context menu to insert the reference a
t your active cursor.

### 2. Tab Navigation & Workspace Viewing
* **Double-Click to Open**: Double-click any file to launc
h it directly into a new DSH editor tab (seamlessly integrating with `betterSidebar`, `sidebarRight`

, or native workspace tabs).
* **Context Menu "Open in New Tab"**: Right-click any file to open it i

n an editor tab.
* **Instant Filter Search**: Top search bar filters files and folders in real time
with instant path matching.

### 3. Motion Collapse Transitions
* **Fluid Grid Animations**: Smooth CSS grid accordion animations

when expanding and collapsing folders.
* **Rotating Chevrons**: Responsive chevron rotation synchro

nized with folder open/close state.
* **Toggleable in Preferences**: Easily disable animations in th
e Options modal for instantaneous snap navigation.

### 4. Git Status Indicators
* **Multi-Repo & Monorepo Support**: Automatic detection of git reposit

ories at workspace root or nested sub-repositories across tools and project folders.
* **Parent Fold
er Bubble-Up**: Ancestor directories reflect modified (`M`), untracked (`U`), or deleted (`D`) state

s of their children, so changes are visible without needing to expand every folder.
* **Refined Pill
Badges**: Right-aligned status badges with subtle tint backgrounds (`M` in warm amber, `U` in soft

green, `D` in coral red).
* **Toggleable in Preferences**: Cleanly hide all Git colors and badges wi
th one switch in the Options modal.

### 5. Compact Folders
* **Single-Child Folder Chaining**: Single-child directory hierarchies (such

as `src/client/ui`) are collapsed into a single compact line.
* **Instant Responsive Toggle**: Turn
Compact Folders on or off in the Options modal with immediate, zero-lag visual re-rendering.

### 6. Scale & Density Customization
* **Density Presets**: Switch between **Compact** (20px rows),

**Normal** (24px rows), and **Relaxed** (28px rows).
* **Continuous Zoom Slider**: Zoom the entire t
ree from **75%** to **135%** scale, automatically adjusting row heights, font sizes, icon sizes, and

indentation step guides.
* **Persistent Preferences**: All display options are saved to local stora
ge and restored automatically.

### 7. Language Icons & Visual Hierarchy
* **Color-Coded File Types**: Hand-tuned colors and badges
for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go, C/C++, HTML, CSS, JSON, Markdown, YAML, Docker, Git, a

nd shell scripts.
* **Directory Guides**: Visual indent guide lines showing nesting levels clearly a

cross deep workspace structures.
* **Hidden Files Toggle**: Toggle visibility of dotfiles and hidden
system configurations.

### 8. Complete File Management
* **Inline Operations**: Hover actions for Mention (@), Copy Relativ

e Path, Rename (F2), and Delete.
* **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard navigation support (Up / D

own arrows, Left / Right collapse / expand, Enter to mention or expand, F2 to rename).
* **Live File
System Watcher**: Instantaneous tree updates via WebSocket server when files are created, modified,
or deleted externally.

## Architecture
* **Host Service (`src/index.ts`, `src/fs-tree.ts`, `src/git-status.ts`)**: Node.js ESM service runn
ing on the DSH Cordis container, providing secure filesystem tree traversal, WebSocket live file-wat

ching, and parallel git status aggregation.
* **Client Surface (`src/client/index.tsx`, `src/client/
ExplorerView.tsx`)**: React UI mounted inside DSH's right sidebar slot (`sidebar.right.panel`), mana

ging reactive tree navigation, drag-and-drop caret tracking, and customizable display preferences.
*
**Self-Contained Distribution**: Build outputs in `lib/` are fully bundled by `esbuild` with inline
d CSS modules, requiring zero external client dependencies at runtime.
